scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev"
scripts.dev:pc: node -e "console.log('\n  PC mode: API reads server/local.config.json (or server/.env). UI uses Vite proxy -> 127.0.0.1:4003\n')" && npm run dev:all
scripts.start:pc: npm run build --prefix server && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run preview -- --host"
scripts.api:kill-old: for p in 4000 4002 4003; do lsof -ti :$p 2>/dev/null; done | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; echo 'Stopped API on 4000/4002/4003 (if any)'
scripts.restart:api: npm run api:kill-old && npm run build --prefix server && npm run start --prefix server
scripts.preview:scripts: npm run build --prefix server && node scripts/preview-call-scripts.mjs
scripts.preview:ai-prompt: npm run build --prefix server && node scripts/preview-ai-prompt.mjs
scripts.build: prisma generate --schema server/prisma/schema.prisma && tsc -b && vite build
